Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{
  "sample_id": "secbench_oss_mruby.ossfuzz-42513630",
  "fine_trace": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "file": "mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c",
      "function": "codegen",
      "line": 3296,
      "var": "p",
      "code": "int off = new_litbn(s, p, base, FALSE);",
      "role": "source",
      "note": "An overflowing integer literal from the Ruby input is emitted as a bigint literal, creating an input-controlled MRB_TT_BIGINT value at runtime."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "file": "mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c",
      "function": "mrb_bint_powm",
      "line": 1346,
      "var": "b3->mp",
      "code": "return mrb_obj_value(b3);",
      "role": "root_cause",
      "note": "For an integer modulus, modular exponentiation returns the unnormalized bigint wrapper for the small modulus instead of the computed normalized result."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "file": "src/numeric.c",
      "function": "num_gt",
      "line": 1930,
      "var": "self",
      "code": "n = cmpnum(mrb, self, other);",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "The returned small bigint is used as the left operand of a greater-than comparison with an integer."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c",
      "function": "mrb_bint_cmp",
      "line": 1305,
      "var": "&b->mp",
      "code": "if (mpz_get_int(&b->mp, &i1)) {",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "Bigint-versus-integer comparison tries to convert the bigint operand back to mrb_int."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "file": "mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c",
      "function": "mpz_get_int",
      "line": 751,
      "var": "y->p[1]",
      "code": "else if (digits(y) > 2 || y->p[1] > 1) {",
      "role": "sink",
      "note": "The small unnormalized bigint has only one allocated limb, so reading y->p[1] performs an out-of-bounds heap read."
    }
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {"file": "mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c", "function": "codegen", "line": 3296, "operands": ["p", "base"]},
    "root_cause": {"file": "mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c", "function": "mrb_bint_powm", "line": 1346, "operands": ["mrb_obj_value(b3)", "bint_norm(mrb, b2)"], "relation": {"op": "eq", "left": "mrb_obj_value(b3)", "right": "bint_norm(mrb, b2)"}},
    "sink": {"file": "mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c", "function": "mpz_get_int", "line": 751, "operands": ["y->sz", "y->p[1]"], "relation": {"op": "gt", "left": "y->sz", "right": "1"}},
    "propagation": [
      {
        "from": {"file": "mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c", "function": "codegen", "line": 3296, "operands": ["p", "base"]},
        "to": {"file": "mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c", "function": "mpz_get_int", "line": 751, "operands": ["y->p[1]"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["OP_LOADL", "mrb_bint_new_str(mrb, s+2, (mrb_int)s[0], (mrb_int)s[1])", "mrb_bint_powm(mrb, x, exp, m)", "mrb_obj_value(b3)", "cmpnum(mrb, self, other)", "mpz_get_int(&b->mp, &i1)"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
